item.title: Major train accident on Bihar-Jharkhand border; 8 wagons derailed, 3 fall into river
item.description: A major train accident occurred on the Bihar–Jharkhand border late Saturday night when eight wagons of a freight train derailed on the Jasidih–Jhajha rail section. Three wagons fell into a river near a bridge, disrupting rail traffic on both tracks. No casualties were reported.

item.title: Gold prices jump Rs 7,040 in a week, Silver soars amid strong demand; Check rates here
item.description: Gold prices surged sharply in India, rising ₹7,040 per 10 grams for 24-carat gold in a week, while silver jumped ₹37,000 per kg. Gold touched record levels in domestic and global markets amid strong investment demand and economic uncertainty.

item.title: Horoscope 2026: What the New Year holds for all 12 Zodiac Signs; Opportunities, warnings and astrological tips
item.description: Astrologer Dr. Diwakar Tripathi shared a detailed horoscope forecast for 2026 on Dynamite News, highlighting planetary impacts on all 12 zodiac signs. He discussed career growth, financial prospects, health concerns, and remedies based on planetary movements.

item.title: Pakistan Army hid in bunkers during Operation Sindoor; Admits Zardari
item.description: Pakistan has always faced global criticism for being a haven for terrorists. During ‘Operation Sindoor,’ the weaknesses of the Pakistani army were exposed when President Asif Ali Zardari admitted that the Pakistani army had hidden in bunkers during a period of heightened tension.

item.title: Balen Shah nominated as Nepal PM candidate; Youth-led alliance forms ahead of Nepal polls
item.description: Kathmandu Metropolitan City Mayor Balen Shah has been nominated as a prime ministerial candidate in Nepal. He and the Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) have reached an agreement to jointly contest the general elections scheduled for March 5. Under this agreement, Balen Shah will contest the elections under the RSP's election symbol, the 'bell,' and an effort will be made to unite youth-led political forces.

item.title: Tripura medical student killed in Dehradun after confronting racial abuse
item.description: The victim has been identified as Anjel Chakma, a resident of Tripura. Anjel was a final-year MBA student at Jigyasa University in Dehradun. He was critically injured in the attack and succumbed to his injuries after fighting for his life in the hospital for several days.

item.title: Salman Khan’s ‘Battle Of Galwan’ teaser sparks pride; Fans praise every frame and scene
item.description: The teaser for ‘Battle of Galwan,’ released on Salman Khan's birthday, is creating a sensation on social media. With 12 million views in 16 hours, fans have showered the teaser with praise, calling it full of patriotism and action. The film stars Salman Khan and Chitrangada Singh in the lead roles. It is based on the 2020 Galwan Valley clash and is scheduled for release on April 17, 2026.

item.title: Bangladesh Minority Janata Party enters elections; Focuses on Hindu votes
item.description: Amidst rising violence against minorities in Bangladesh, a new political party for Hindus, the Bangladesh Minority Janata Party (BMJP), has entered the electoral arena. The party plans to contest 91 seats, focusing on areas with a significant Hindu voter base. The party's main agenda is to ensure minority rights, secularism, and a just society.

item.title: BMC Polls: Samajwadi Party releases second list of candidates; Click for details
item.description: Earlier the Party declared its first list of 21 candidates. The nams were announced by the Party's Maharashtra President Abu Azmi. According to SP sources the Party plans to contest all 227 seats independently.

item.title: PM Modi discusses 2025 achievements in last ‘Mann Ki Baat’ of the year; Here’s key highlights
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, in his radio program 'Mann Ki Baat', discussed the country's achievements and the prospects for the new year 2026. He described 'Operation Sindoor' as a symbol of pride for every Indian. Emphasizing sports, science, youth talent, and cultural heritage, PM Modi encouraged young people to participate in innovation, hackathons, and the preservation of language and culture.
